Woke up with a grateful heart and a smile still on my face. Salamat sa isa na namang araw punong-puno ng kilig, tawa, at pagmamahal! 💙

To @UniRABofficial , @RH_ANGELS, and our ever-solid mother fandom @RABIN_HOUSE, thank you for the unity and passion you pour into everything. And of course, to our generous and ever-supportive Ates, @Chrissy and @Rabinbliss, grabe kayo. You’re the heartbeat behind these upcoming MOA-EDSA fan projects. Hindi biro ang effort and love na binubuhos ninyo, and we see it, we feel it. We love you! 

Let's keep the fire burning mga mamsh! We’re so lucky to be part of this journey with Rabin, and even luckier to have each other. 

Have a great day or night Dabins! Don't forget to thank the Lord, always. 💙
